product_timing_review.policy: The target package appears only in source-matched product windows; non-product food shots contain no retail package.
product_timing_review.method: Every accepted frame is an ImageGen generation from a registered scene master, plus the original product photo only when the source product is visible. No code compositing or previous keyframe reference was used.

shot_method_review.policy: Camera height, angle, framing, subject transition and package timing follow the 13-shot source map; H3 prompts carry the exact cut timing and motion.
